text:
nina: uploaded a compact mock for the stackframe list — main questions: should frames auto-collapse by file/module and where to surface the Export action? figma: https://www.figma.com/file/stackframe-compact :mag:

rohan: auto-collapse helps noise but make it obvious frames are collapsed. show a chevron + a counter ("+3 frames") so users know there's more.

mike: +1. also add a keyboard affordance: when focus is on a frame row, pressing Right arrow expands, Left arrow collapses. add aria-expanded on the row.

jamie: Export placement: I think it belongs in the header for the trace details (top-right), not per-frame. exporting is about the whole event not a single frame. per-frame copy should be a small copy icon on each frame.

nina: agree on per-frame copy icon. we also considered a bulk checkbox to select frames to export (for CSV of interesting frames). happy to include that as an advanced option.

rohan: about copy icon: when clicked, we should announce which value copied. e.g., "Frame location copied: src/runtime/engine.cc:412". use role=status + aria-live=polite.

mike: also ensure the copy icon has a visible focus ring and accessible name: aria-label="Copy frame location". tooltips are fine but not relied on for accessibility.

jamie: what about long file paths — they truncate visually. on copy, copy the full path. show a transient inline message: "Copied full path". avoid blocking toasts.

a11y-bot: checklist: collapsed groups must have button role with aria-expanded, groups should announce child count. Ensure chevron is in the interactive element. Keyboard: Enter/Space to toggle, Arrow keys for navigation between rows. Use skip link "Skip to frames" from header. Color contrast for chevron and counters must be >=4.5:1.

nina: good. question: should Export modal include a preview of CSV columns? users asked for column selection.

rohan: yes show a small preview table with first 3 rows and checkboxes for columns. default columns: timestamp, frame, module, thread_id, context. allow reordering.

mike: backend note: we'll need an endpoint that accepts a columns list and selection of frames (id array) and returns a job id if large. can implement.

jamie: microcopy: change "Export" to "Export selected frames (CSV)" in the header overflow. if nothing selected, grey it and tooltip "Select frames to export".

nina: mobile collapse: single select mode only; bulk export lives behind the kebab. on narrow widths hide counters.

a11y-bot: modal must trap focus, have role=dialog and labelledby, and provide keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl+E to open export modal (announce this in a tooltip). Ensure modal close returns focus to triggering control.

rohan: i'll add keyboard behavior notes to the ticket. nina can you update the mock to show collapsed groups, copy icon, and export modal preview?

nina: yes will upload updated frames by EOD with annotations. thanks all. :sparkles:
